description: end-4's illogical-impulse (ii) desktop shell for Hyprland, ported to run natively on Windows 10 and 11: bar, workspaces, search, widgets, screen recording and Material You colours from your wallpaper.
notes: The shell itself runs as qsw.exe; press Win+/ for the keybind list.

This is the portable package. The official ii-windows-setup.exe (same release) installs to %LOCALAPPDATA%\ii-windows with autostart, terminal theming and update notifications; scoop cannot replace that setup.
